    Matrix operator*(const Matrix& other) const {
        Matrix res;
        res.size = size;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                res.mat[i][j] = 0;

                    res.mat[i][j] = (res.mat[i][j] + mat[i][k] * other.mat[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
};

    base[0][0].size = m + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
        base[0][0].mat[i][i] = 1;
        base[0][0].mat[0][i] = 1;
    }

    ULL y = 1, add = 0;
    int x = 0, z = 0;

    while (y * m <= n) {
        y *= m;
        ++x;
    }

    for (int t = 0; t <= x; ++t) {

            for (int i = 1; i < m; ++i) {
                base[t][0] = base[t][0] * base[t-1][i];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < m; ++i) {
            base[t][i] = base[t][i-1];

                    swap(base[t][i].mat[j][k], base[t][i].mat[j+1][k]);
                }

            for (int j = m - 2; j >= 0; --j) {

                    swap(base[t][i].mat[k][j], base[t][i].mat[k][j+1]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    identity.size = m + 1;
